author: Irina
text: This was my first regatta and a very successful experience! Igor is an engaged captain who knows how to organise a team, share out responsibility and get everyone working together. He and Sofa worked in sync and sorted out every bit of trouble that came up. Despite the large number of beginners (me and Vera, for example), we quickly became a team - we trained really well, raced, supported each other and still found time to have fun. We managed to combine adventure with the atmosphere of real racing!
